title: Arizer Whip for Extreme Q or V-Tower
description:
Elevate your vaping experience with the Arizer Whip, specifically crafted for the Extreme Q and V-Tower vaporizers. This meticulously designed 3′ whip kit includes high-quality glass components such as a glass adapter with screens and a glass mouthpiece, ensuring you receive the purest flavor and smoothest draws every time. Ideal for desktop vaporizers, the Arizer Whip seamlessly integrates with both the Extreme Q and V-Tower, enhancing efficiency and performance.

Enhance your sessions with this essential accessory and experience the ultimate in vaping precision. The kit’s glass screen guarantees that each inhale is clean and enjoyable, making it a must-have for any serious vaper. Available now in our menu, add the Arizer Whip to your collection and transform your Extreme Q or V-Tower vaporizer into a peak-performance machine.
